remarks: Luxury building in the highly desirable Glenbrook area. Upgraded kitchen with granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, and custom cabinets. Refinished parquet floors throughout, built-in wardrobe, storage, and laundry facility. A separate sleeping area can be used as additional sleeping quarters or an office. One reserved parking space in a secured lot. Heat , hot water, and cooking gas are included in rent. Close proximity to Stamford Mall, Metro, and Entertainment. Good credit is a must. Subject to credit check $40.
